result.finding: Application uses Spring profiles with 3 configurations: default (application.properties for general use with Oracle DB), 'docker' (application-docker.properties for containerized deployment), and 'test' (application-test.properties using H2 in-memory DB for unit tests). No Maven profiles or @Profile-annotated beans found.
evidence: application.properties: default profile — Oracle DB at oracle-db:1521/FREEPDB1, DDL auto=create, debug logging

application-test.properties: 'test' profile — H2 in-memory DB (jdbc:h2:mem:testdb), H2Dialect, DDL auto=create-drop, suppressed SQL logging
docker-compose.yml sets SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=docker for containerized run
No @Profile annotations in source code (no profile-specific Spring beans)
